D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Walks/GallaiRo.signature: theorem colorable_iff_exists_orientation [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) : G.Colorable k ↔ ∃ o : V → V → Prop, IsOrientation G o ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → V), IsDirectedPath o f → m ≤ k
